title: St. Claude Street home and church
summary: The family home on St. Claude, St. Augustine church, and her marriage at the unfinished St. Joseph church.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You lived over on St. Claude Street in those days, was it?
St. Claude? There we all was born. My grandmother had 13 or 23 grandchildren. All born on St. Claude, between Calarec and Columbus. All born right there in that house.
You went to that church over on St. Claude, what is the name of this?
St. Augustine. St. Augustine. St. Claude and Governor Nicholas, they call it now. Used to be called by road. Now they call it Governor Nicholas.
And where were you married? Were you married in that church?
And on Tulane Street? Yes. I was told you then, Bill, when we passed by.
It wasn't built. It wasn't complete. It just had start building it. They didn't have no windows, no confessional bars, no nothing. Okay? When I married there.
